records.rationale: The policy record in intake.md shows the policy in force on the 2025-11-15 date of loss, with no prior claims. Repair estimate BV-7718 (repair_estimate.md, written 2025-11-17) matches the $4,480 intake amount and the VIN, its figures add up, and it describes flood damage to sill height with no body damage. That account agrees with adjuster_notes.md and with the overnight Flash Flood Warning in weather_notice.md. No contradictions or denial indicators were found in any source. The evidence checklist is incomplete because no damage photographs are on file: status_history.md records 'no photograph attached', and adjuster_notes.md says 'Need a photo of the car before this moves.' Photographs should be requested from the policyholder. The adjuster may also wish to confirm three things: that the dealer lot lies within the warned area of northern Boulder County, the time of loss, and whether dealer-stock vehicles are covered under this policy.
